[[File:Rhuarc.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Rhuarc]], clan chief of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].]]
[[Aiel]] '''''clan chief''s''' have authority over the several [[sept]]s of their clan. Unlike nobles of the [[Westlands]], any Aiel may speak with the clan chief and while there are some formalities, they are not afforded the same sort of servile adulation as "wetlander kings."

[[File:Bruan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Bruan]], clan chief of the Nakai Aiel.]]
They are chosen from among the clan's male members by the [[Wise One]]s, who must agree to allow the candidate to travel to [[Rhuidean]]. There he learns the true history of the Aiel through the memories of his ancestors. If he returns, he is marked by a single dragon tattoo on his forearm and becomes the new clan chief. Only one in three men survive this trip to Rhuidean.

===Fourth Age Clan Chiefs===
During [[Aviendha]]'s second visit to [[Rhuidean]], she sees visions of the future which show her descendents in the [[Fourth Age]]. While it is open to interpretation whether these events are destined to occur, we include the list of Clan Chiefs mentioned here for completeness. The dates are the approximate date we see them as clan chief in the books. In the absence of any canonical calendar for the Fourth Age, we use a continuation of the New Era in which the [[Last Battle]] occurs in {{ne|1000}}.
